Later corrections and required reuse/exclusions can qualify even when the repair is simple after the fact.
An unrequired exact detail, isolated count, refusal, missing write or tool error alone cannot qualify.
Shared causes across artifacts count once; one binary discovery is weaker than several independent consequential chains.

hardness_v6_validation.calibration_record_scope: Rules review and worked transfer-class examples only. It is not a predictor and never an input to the score of a task under review; Eval 1A's ban on requesting another model's runs or grades for the screened task is unchanged.
manual_boundary_review: A pattern match by evidence shape is necessary and never sufficient; check 4 decides transfer.
An unissued search, an unopened pointer, an unread returned record and a rule stated verbatim in a held source are all CAPABILITY_FLOOR, however consequential they were in the observed run.
A CAPABILITY_FLOOR chain is still logged as a real model failure with qualifies false; it is not deleted from the ledger.
The observed failure must sit at the step that survives retrieval; an unsettled question the run never reached is recorded as unobserved and not credited.
Clause count, cohort size, service count and tool-call volume do not lift the enumerated_single_source cap.
An all-CAPABILITY_FLOOR screen with adequate coverage is scored low difficulty, not insufficient evidence, and reserves INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for coverage gaps and confounds.
Hardening advice for such a HOLD must target what the sources leave open, not more sources or rows.
hardness_v6_validation.history_note: Prior validation entries describe their recorded versions. This entry checks only the named scope; existing unrelated edits and validation history are preserved.

hardness_v7_validation.scope: Adds the cohort-sweep route and the SCALE_COMPLETENESS transfer class. A sweep chain qualifies only when four conjunctive task-design conditions hold on the golden: record-level retrieval across a source-defined cohort in the long-horizon band, no bulk call holding the evidence, exact totals derived per record, and a per-record predicate that is more than a lookup. scale_evidence records paired_runs or design_only, the latter advancing a task provisionally as DESIGN_SCALE_UNPAIRED. The decision_rule_source cap now yields to a credited sweep chain. Score bands, the verdict vocabulary and the below-75% target are unchanged, and volume, row count, clause count, service count and tool-call count still establish nothing on their own.
hardness_v7_validation.motivation: A v6 re-screen of task 6aa8272b1b7a2df0fc0fea91 scored Easy / 2 / FAIL / HOLD. Six later claude-opus-4-8 runs on the same prompt and injection returned 70.2% average weighted rubric pass on the baseline verifier with 0% pass@1, and every run missed the same two derived flag totals despite completing the 133-row sweep. v6 could not see that difficulty for two structural reasons: check 4 assumes complete retrieval, which is the tested skill on a cohort audit, and check 2 requires an observed failure in a screening run that abandoned the inventory after 19 calls.
hardness_v7_validation.report_contract_code_change: hg_report_contract.py now accepts QUALIFYING_COHORT_SWEEP and DESIGN_SCALE_UNPAIRED as gate reasons on a PROCEED, keeping INSUFFICIENT_DIFFICULTY as the only HOLD reason and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE as the only unscored reason. The score-to-gate and score-to-difficulty tables are unchanged.

revalidation.6aa8272b1b7a2df0fc0fea91: Re-screened under v7: NON-FAIL / 3 / Hard / PROCEED / QUALIFYING_COHORT_SWEEP, validated through hg_report_contract.py. All six observed Haiku chains remain CAPABILITY_FLOOR or execution-only; the gate rests on the golden's four sweep conditions plus paired runs. The v5 text is preserved at reports/1a_hardness_v5.md.
revalidation.6aa8272b1b7a2df0fc0fea8d: No-regression check: the cohort-sweep route was applied and rejected. Conditions 1, 2 and 4 fail because the cohort is twelve keys enumerated in the ticket the prompt points at and the deciding evidence sits in a few shared sources. Unchanged at Easy / 2 / FAIL / HOLD / INSUFFICIENT_DIFFICULTY, recorded in cohort_sweep in its hardness_assessment.json.
